# Bank Transfer Process Clause

Controls when a bank transfer may be requested within a Bank Transfer Contract. `paymentPolicyAction` is fixed to `transfer`, and `readParametersFromDocument` is `true`. The bank remains the sole source of transfer completion. All paths refer to the executing instruction’s own document, including when that instruction is nested.

Configuration uses the clause’s `parameters`:

- `parameters.method` defaults to `bank-transfer`; `conditional-bank` is also accepted. Other values are rejected.
- `parameters.transfer` defaults to `{}`. Its `mode` defaults to `workflow`; only `workflow` and `when` are supported. `workflow` does not add the conditional gate and automatic request handlers described below.
- In `when` mode, `parameters.transfer.when` is required and must evaluate to exactly `true` to permit requesting. `parameters.transfer.requestId` must be nonempty text; transfer execution limits it to 128 characters.
- `parameters.sources` defaults to `{}` and declares source aliases used by the predicate.

The predicate permits `$document`, `$eq`, `$ne`, `$lt`, `$lte`, `$gt`, `$gte`, `$and`, `$or`, `$not`, `$exists`, `$includes`, `$size`, `$add`, `$subtract` and `$literal`, with `list` and `val` operand fields. `$document` references must be static absolute paths other than `/`; references under `/sources/<alias>/` require a declared alias. `$literal` contents are not scanned. Unsupported syntax and nesting exceeding 33 scan levels are rejected. The clause’s transition validator rejects policy changes as `PAYMENT_PROCESS_POLICY_IMMUTABLE`.

In `when` mode, the clause initializes `/paymentProcess_<clauseKey>/transferAllowed` to `false` and stores that path in `/paymentTerms/transferGate`. An existing different gate path is rejected. Updates to `/payment`, `/bankTransfer`, `/activation`, `/sourceLinks` and predicate-referenced paths reevaluate the gate; nonempty `parameters.sources` also adds an embedded-node event handler. The gate becomes true only when `/activation/active` is exactly `true`, the predicate is exactly `true`, and either `/clauses/documentSources` is absent or `/sourceLinks/ready` is exactly `true`.

After reevaluation, an automatic request is attempted only when the gate is true, `/payment/accepted` is exactly `true`, `/payment/closed` is exactly `false`, and `/bankTransfer/status` is `idle`. Otherwise that request step takes no action. It supplies the configured `requestId` with `sourceMode: event`, bypassing the manual payer-channel check. Missing runtime values do not imply these required values or the gate’s initialization value.

Manual `requestTransfer` accepts only `requestId` and requires the caller channel to match `/paymentTerms/payerChannel`. Both request routes require acceptance and, when document sources are declared, source readiness. A new request is rejected if payment is explicitly closed or an existing transfer gate does not resolve to exactly `true`. It records `/bankTransfer/requestId`, sets `/bankTransfer/status` to `requested`, and emits a Bank Transfer Event with `kind: Transfer Requested`. The amount comes from `/paymentTerms/amountMinor`, in integer minor units of `/paymentTerms/currency`; the caller does not choose it. Repeating the stored request identifier returns `duplicate` without another request event, before checking closure or the gate again; a different identifier conflicts. A recorded request is not transferred or secured money.

Bank outcomes use `confirmTransfer`, `declineTransfer` or `reportTransferUnknown`. The caller channel must match `/paymentTerms/guarantorChannel`. Each requires the recorded `requestId` and a nonempty bank `reference` of at most 256 characters. Confirmation additionally requires `amountMinor` and `currency` to match `/paymentTerms/amountMinor` and `/paymentTerms/currency` exactly. Those fields are optional for decline or unknown reports and do not establish completion. Public workflows also invoke `requireActive`; its detailed checks are not supplied here.

New outcomes are accepted from `requested` or `unknown`. Thus an unknown outcome can later reconcile to `completed` or `declined` for the same request. Repeating the same status and reference returns `duplicate`, subject to the input checks; a conflicting reference for that status or a change from a terminal outcome is rejected. Accepted outcomes update `/bankTransfer/status` and `/bankTransfer/reference` and emit `Transfer Outcome`.

Only completion sets `/payment/completed` to the full instruction amount, sets `/payment/transactionId` to the bank reference, and emits Payment Completed with `amountCompleted` and `evidence: bankConfirmation`. This is a recorded amount, not an accumulated total. Gate changes do not cancel or reverse a transfer. This bank process has no synthetic authorization or capture stage; a refund requires a separate transfer instruction.
